newRelationTypes.name: located-in
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject entity is geographically or administratively based in the target location or country.

newRelationTypes.name: delivers
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject malware or tool is used to distribute or deploy the target payload.

newRelationTypes.name: downloads-from
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject entity retrieves data or payloads from the target domain, URL, or host.

newRelationTypes.name: loads
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject entity decrypts, unpacks, or executes the target component in memory or on disk.

newRelationTypes.name: protected-by
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject software file or malware is protected or obfuscated using the target software product.

newRelationTypes.name: contains
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject file or package embeds or bundles the target tool or payload inside itself.

newRelationTypes.name: develops
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject organisation or author created or maintains the target software product.

newRelationTypes.name: disables
newRelationTypes.definition: The subject tool or command deactivates or stops the operation of the target security software.
